name: cc-enslaver
description: A Claude Code plugin and LLM-agnostic rule pack that enforces systematic thinking, verified citations, and root-cause analysis — eliminating reactive, lazy AI behavior. v0.21 inverts the i18n architecture: English is now the skeleton / source-of-truth language (rules/ + prompts/ at the root, default runtime injection), Chinese is a first-class translation (rules/zh/ + prompts/zh/, via CC_ENSLAVER_LANG=zh), any language code is accepted (falls back to the English skeleton), and drift is CI-blocked by hooks/scripts/i18n_check.py + tests/test_i18n_sync.py — on drift, English wins. v0.20 collapses the agent's reply skeleton into a fixed YAML schema whose field names ARE the existing Stop-hook detection markers (no detector changed) and adds Stop layer (h): a hard-enforced one-sentence plain-language TL;DR required on every done-claim reply.
